import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
# deck slab
ax.fill([-3,3,3,-3], [2.0,2.0,1.7,1.7], color='lightgray')
ax.text(0, 1.85, 'deck slab (unchanged top view)', ha='center', fontsize=8)
# parapets
ax.fill([-3,-2.6,-2.6,-3], [2.0,2.0,3.0,3.0], color='gray')
ax.fill([3,2.6,2.6,3], [2.0,2.0,3.0,3.0], color='gray')
ax.text(-2.8, 3.1, 'parapet void', ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax.text(2.8, 3.1, 'parapet void', ha='center', fontsize=7)
# girders below
ax.fill([-2.2,-1.8,-1.8,-2.2], [1.7,1.7,0.2,0.2], color='dimgray')
ax.fill([2.2,1.8,1.8,2.2], [1.7,1.7,0.2,0.2], color='dimgray')
ax.text(-2.0, 0.9, 'girder (fixed)', ha='center', fontsize=7, rotation=90)
ax.text(2.0, 0.9, 'girder (fixed)', ha='center', fontsize=7, rotation=90)
# cross beam
ax.fill([-2.2,2.2,2.2,-2.2], [0.2,0.2,-0.1,-0.1], color='darkgray')
ax.text(0, 0.05, 'cross frame (fixed support)', ha='center', fontsize=7)
# TMD masses (moving)
ax.fill([-1.0,-0.2,-0.2,-1.0], [0.6,0.6,0.1,0.1], color='steelblue')
ax.fill([0.2,1.0,1.0,0.2], [0.6,0.6,0.1,0.1], color='steelblue')
ax.text(-0.6, 0.35, 'TMD mass (moving)', ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax.text(0.6, 0.35, 'TMD mass (moving)', ha='center', fontsize=7)
# springs/dampers vertical
for x in [-0.85,-0.35,0.35,0.85]:
    ax.plot([x,x], [-0.1,0.1], color='black', lw=1.5)
    ax.text(x, -0.25, 'spring+damper', ha='center', fontsize=6)
ax.text(0, -0.6, 'soffit zone hidden from deck, access hatch below', ha='center', fontsize=8, style='italic')
ax.set_xlim(-3.5,3.5); ax.set_ylim(-1,3.5); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
